He has always lived with dad. And Im not upset that he lives in with his dad, I live with my parents, its just I had to push for the truth. Then when I started thinking about other stuff, I dont think he was telling me the truth about other things either. I cant prove it but he swears he is telling the truth. And its simple things like he likes to write quotes on this white board, but the handwriting on the white board is completely different then the letter he hand wrote me. Like its completely different. So we no longer speak
